_doc: Aggregates that cannot be recomputed from generations.csv. Exported from the private experiment; values only, no text.

historical_L_production_telemetry._doc: Earlier production Read-agent V1 worker, read-only telemetry. Different jobs and days from the dev run; never paired with it.

spend_ledger_usd._doc: CLI-reported list-price equivalent, not subscription cash. 'B' includes B and B_prime.

auditor_test_cases._doc: Constructed claims with known defects, run against the private corpus. v1 and v2 were used to change the auditor, so they are regression tests, not held-out evidence.
